_notes: Rowamet Heavy Metal: the Taito do Brasil board (platform taito) with a Z80 as the main CPU - PinMAME's rowamet
machine imports the taito machine and replaces its CPU - plus Rowamet's own Z80 sound board. Same memory map: two
4KB ROMs at 0x0000, 512 bytes of scratch RAM at 0x3E00 and the 256-byte battery-backed window at 0x4000 that the
taito driver saves as the .nv file, with the display and command DMA inside it.
